title: corsairdev/corsair: open integrations for connecting agents to user applications
friendlyTitle: Corsair connects AI agents to the apps people already use
summary: Corsair is an Apache-licensed integration platform for connecting applications and agents to users’ external services. It offers self-hosting, integration plugins and an optional hosted hub for OAuth refresh and webhooks, keeping the connection layer inspectable.
friendlySummary: This open-source project helps developers add service connections, login permissions and webhooks to applications and agents.
whyItMatters: Product teams can reuse authentication and integration plumbing instead of building each connector from scratch, while retaining a self-hosted option for sensitive deployments. Review every plugin’s scopes, token storage and webhook exposure before granting an agent access.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can save integration work and can be self-hosted, but teams should give each agent only the permissions it truly needs.
